title: U.S. Marine accused of killing woman in Japan, drawing official protest from Tokyo
summary_full: Devin Jacob Ballard was arrested in the killing and robbing of Anna Yagi, police told Japan’s public broadcaster. He denied the allegations, a spokesman said.
